thread:
Zoe: Quick thread: we need to finalize the preemptible "graceband" policy for reserved pools. Customer ask: allow short preemptible delta (graceband) so launches aren't instantly evicted. Choices: a) fixed graceband (e.g., 5m) with immediate eviction after, b) usage-weighted graceband (longer for clients with steady baseline), c) credit-based graceband (minutes consumed from carryover). Need decision for GA and runbook notes.

Harish: My vote: credit-based. It's fair and ties into billing. But it's more infra work (tracking per-tenant credits).

Kim: Ops: fixed graceband is simplest to operate and test. However it can be gamed by noisy tenants. Usage-weighted seems risky to compute at scale. Credit-based + per-tenant cap avoids cliffs.

Dana: From product: customers want predictability during launches. Recommendation: default credit-based with a small built-in free graceband (5m/month) for all tiers, plus purchasable blocks. Also add an emergency waive path for scheduled launches.

Victor: Runtime note: when graceband is active we should tag sessions as "soft-preempt" so router can prefer KV-affine placement. On reclaim we should trigger prewarm for affected tenants to reduce 99.99 spikes.

Zoe: Good. Also need explicit eviction ordering: 1) opportunistic background jobs, 2) best-effort model variants, 3) soft-preempt sessions (last), unless customer opted into deeper preemption.

Harish: Logging/telemetry: emit events "graceband-start", "graceband-end", "graceband-reclaim-reason". Expose per-tenant meter in Console and a monthly usage CSV export for billing.

Kim: Runbook: alert when >5 tenants consuming graceband concurrently for >15m in a region. Pager only if consumption >75% of global graceband pool for >30m. Mitigation: start soft admission control and DM customers.

Dana: Contract language: call it "Preemptible Graceband" with examples: "Standard: 5 free minutes/month; Enterprise: 60m/month included; overages billed in 1h blocks or converted to credits." Keep wording simple for sales.

Victor: Tests: add chaos test that reclaims graceband mid-canary and verify fallback to compat-fallback model and no SLA breach longer than threshold. Also load tests for 100 concurrent graceband events.

Zoe: Decision proposal for GA: default = credit-based with a 5m free graceband/month, per-burst cap 15m, opt-in scheduled-waiver path, eviction order as above, prewarm signal on sustained usage >10m. Owners: Harish->credit-tracking proto, Victor->router tags + prewarm, Kim->runbook + alerts, Dana->contracts/pricing copy. Decision by EOD Wednesday.

ops-bot: scheduled: create-epic "preemptible-graceband" assigned to @Zoe,@Harish,@Victor,@Kim,@Dana due 2025-05-09

Harish: I'll prototype a lightweight credit ledger and a CSV export for billing. ETA 2w.

Victor: I'll add the soft-preempt tag and prewarm hooks. ETA 10d.

Kim: I'll draft runbook alerts and add a dashboard tile.

Dana: I'll write the customer-facing FAQ + contract blurb and pricing table.

Zoe: Thanks everyone. If anyone objects to credit-based default, flag now; otherwise we'll lock on Wednesday. :thumbsup:
